bio: The Krainers offer a comprehensive experience with their family-run restaurant, café and hotel. In a bright and modern conservatory-like setting, Andreas Krainer serves up delicious Austrian dishes made with in-season local produce. Some highlights on the menu include the house goulash, Pöllau beef steaks and Mürztal fish hash, along with traditional Austrian desserts. In addition to the Wirtshaus offering, there is also a fine dining restaurant experience in the evening. And it is certainly worth calling by the cake buffet in the café. Hotel patrons can look forward to cosy accommodation, as well as a stylish and modern sauna and relaxation area....
